title: fix(plugin-detail): the record page's inline edit reads the stored row's field locks
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8YRPwyS92zNyQH7W2xooZeG)_
Fixes #27146

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录详情页的行内编辑（`record:details` 正文与 `record:highlights` 高亮条）改问服务器对这条记录的字段投影，不再只读不含行的 `/auth/me/permissions`。
- 为什么改：带 `when` 的字段锁（如审批后锁定摘要）在草稿行上也被禁用，而服务器其实允许写；编辑对话框已在 #27137 修好，详情页是剩下的一处。
- 风险与回滚：只在行内编辑会话可编辑、记录有 id、数据源有 `getRecordFieldAccess` 时才多发一次请求；两个区块同页时各问一次。回滚即还原三个 plugin-detail 文件。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx`、`renderers/record-details.tsx`、`renderers/record-highlights.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-blocks.recordFieldAccess-27146.test.tsx`，预期 10 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无,席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- New `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx` (`RecordFieldAccessForRecord`, internal, not exported): mounts `RecordFieldAccessScope` (`@object-ui/permissions`) for the block's stored record when the page's inline-edit session may edit (`canEdit`), the block offers in-place edit, the record has an id and the data source carries `getRecordFieldAccess`. Below it, the unchanged `resolveFieldAffordance('recordEdit', …)` calls in `DetailSection` and `HeaderHighlight` read the server's projection for that row (ruling 6457467702, letter B: the server's answer, no client `when` evaluator). It asks again on a write the data source reports for the record and on the data-invalidation bus for it, the triggers the form's `RecordFieldAccessForForm` holds.
- `record:details` wraps its `DetailView` in it (gated on its own `inlineEdit` verdict); `record:highlights` wraps its `HeaderHighlight`.
- `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`: the record-scoped projection paragraph now names the record page's in-place edit as a reader, and states the card's declared limitation — a list view's inline edit locks a whole column and keeps the row-blind answer.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

### Why the mount sits on the two blocks, not on the page host

Measured on `origin/main` `b322b5da`: `record:details` and `record:highlights` are sibling blocks of the page schema; their nearest common ancestors are the page host's providers in `app-shell` `RecordDetailView` and the generic page renderer, so no `plugin-detail` point covers both. The dispatch's fallback was one wrapper in `RecordDetailView`, but a scope there would also cover the page's action dialogs and related lists: `RecordFieldAccessScope` dedupes only a nested scope for the SAME record, so a form editing ANOTHER row of the same object (a self-referencing child, say) would read this row's answer until its own arrived, or for good if its ask failed. Mounting on the two bodies keeps the answer on the surfaces that edit this row. The cost: a page drawing both blocks asks twice per load and per save.

### Why a copy of the trigger lines rather than a shared export

`RecordFieldAccessForForm` lives in `@object-ui/plugin-form` and is not exported; `plugin-detail` does not depend on `plugin-form`, and `@object-ui/permissions` does not depend on `@object-ui/react` (the bus hook). Sharing it would mean a new published export (Clause-② yes) or a new dependency edge, so the ~20 trigger lines are repeated with a note naming the twin.

## Tests

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-blocks.recordFieldAccess-27146.test.tsx`, for each of `record:details` and `record:highlights` under the record page's providers (`MePermissionsProvider` serving the conditioned entry as its lock, record context, inline-edit session):

- a draft the server unlocks: `summary` edits in place, `ref_no` (locked on every row) stays a read display;
- an approved row: `summary` stays locked;
- a write after which the server judges the row approved: asked again, `summary` locks;
- CONTROL: a data source without `getRecordFieldAccess` keeps the row-blind lock;
- CONTROL: a session that may not edit asks nothing.

Ablation (one-shot, not kept): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` turned the wrapper's `if (!asks)` into an always-true condition (the scope never mounts; anchor 1 → 0, blob `2cbc16ec79d0` → `c38590de709a`): 6 of 10 red (the draft, approved and re-ask rows for both blocks), the 4 controls green; restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The record overlay payload `RecordDetailPanel` (kanban / calendar / gantt record drawers) draws the same `DetailSection` and its in-place edit still reads the row-blind answer. Not changed here: its saves run through the host's `onFieldSave`, so the re-ask trigger needs its own reading. Noted for the seat.
- `HeaderHighlight` inside `DetailView` (an authored `highlightFields` header) is covered on the record page through the `record:details` mount.
